description: Publish one of the signed-in organiser's draft events, so anyone with its link can see it (Windline: at tour., event. or ride.windline.tech/<address>). Private events can't be published. ALWAYS ask the user to confirm first, then call with confirm: true.

address.description: Windline: the public address, lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, e.g. "cape-coast-2027".

confirm.description: true only after the user said yes.

event_id.description: The draft's id, from list_my_events or create_event.

name: publish_event

outputSchema.description: The event, now public, and its link.

app.description: The account's app: windline or runfast.

clubs.description: list_my_events on RunFast: the clubs they run ({ slug, name }).

days.description: The plan: each day with its file, from, to, km, climbing and start.

error.description: When the call failed: what went wrong, in words for the user.

events.description: list_my_events: each event with id, name, status (draft or published), dates, km, finished, and its dashboard and public links.

link.description: A private event: its private link (Windline) or where the app opens it (RunFast).

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the user (no match, not live yet, a question back).

note.description: The plan: when the file numbers and the map disagree.

order.description: The plan (view tour_plan): how the days were ordered.

pages.description: list_my_events on Windline: the club and organiser pages they run ({ slug, name, type }). Ask who a new ride is for when there are any.

signup.description: Without a sign-in: { label, url } to make a free Windline or RunFast account (?ref=mcp).

sponsor_line.description: The line every answer ends with: who brings livedot's live tracking free.

view.description: What this answer is; "none" when there is nothing to show (see message).

visibility.description: private (just for them) or shared (for a group).

title: Publish an event
